content.comment_body: Hello. I'm being asked for this password when setting up a new device. What should I do in such cases?

Hello [user_name], English is the preferred language in this forum. Please write your posts in English. Thank you. Translation: Which [product_name] do you have exactly? Please provide the complete [article_no]. You might try the default password: [product_name].

This issue can occur if the version of the [product_name] and the version in your software do not match. Ensure that both versions are identical. Alternatively, provide more details as suggested by @ixo65, including the specific device, software version, and the version specified in your software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users may receive an unexpected password request when connecting [product_name] software to a new hardware module. Common issues include confusion over the correct password and possible mismatches between device and software versions, resulting in difficulty connecting without community advice.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy connection process between the software and new hardware, with clear instructions or default settings to avoid unnecessary password or configuration requirements.
